newsitem.title: UK: British charity pulls staff out of Albania.
newsitem.headline: British charity pulls staff out of Albania.

text.p: A British charity said on Monday that it had pulled its British and Irish staff out of Albania, where they arrived four weeks ago to set up a children's hospital in the southern port of Sarande.

The Children in Distress charity said the staff had been withdrawn on the advice of the British Foreign Office because of the worsening situation in Albania. Sarande has been the scene of rioting by anti-government rebels.
The eight staff members, all nurses, were withdrawn either to Romania, where the charity has another hospice, or to Britain.
